A1.what: the batch spec file is a JSON array of {op, key, value, rid, ts} objects
A1.basis: §14.3 names `batch.json` (a JSON file); §5's tuple names the five fields; the requirements pin no shape
A1.arbitration: if `apply --batch` exits 2 or 3 on the oracle's file, the affected tests (E2, E3, E4, E9) are neither a product failure nor a FALSE PASS: they are reported to the owner as ORACLE-ASSUMPTION-A1 with the delivery's documented shape quoted; the oracle is not edited during W1

A2.what: `Ledger(path)` — the constructor takes the ledger path
A2.basis: §13 names the class; §5/§6/§7 speak of `the JSONL path`; nothing else is pinned
A2.arbitration: a TypeError from the constructor → ORACLE-ASSUMPTION-A2, same handling as A1 (E7, E8, E9)

A3.what: the snapshot document is a JSON object keyed by key (or an array of {key, value} entries)
A3.basis: §6: `a deterministic, sorted JSON document representing the current materialized state: for each key, the most recent committed put value`
A3.arbitration: any other shape → ORACLE-ASSUMPTION-A3 for E2's key-order and key-set assertions; the byte-determinism assertion stands on its own

A4.what: a `fresh ledger` (§14.1) is an existing file holding no record
A4.basis: §9 makes a missing file an I/O error (exit 3), so the fresh ledger of §14.1 must exist
A4.arbitration: none needed: both readings are asserted separately (exit 0 on the empty file, exit 3 on the missing path)

A5.what: a truncated final line is corruption for `verify` (exit 5)
A5.basis: §3.3/§3.4: verify recomputes every line from disk; a line that does not parse cannot match a stored hash → ok=False → §9 exit 5
A5.arbitration: a verify exit of 0 over a truncated tail is reported as a §3.3 finding; if the owner rules the tail is `not a line`, E4's first assertion is withdrawn by the owner, never by the oracle

A6.what: `ledgerlock.ledger` is importable with the project root on sys.path

A7.what: a `delete` on a key with no prior mutation is permitted and produces a tombstone
A7.basis: §4.4: `A delete produces a tombstone line`; nothing restricts deletes to live keys; this is the only tombstone path §4.2 leaves unambiguous (AMB-3)
A7.arbitration: a refusal (exception / exit ≠ 0) → ORACLE-ASSUMPTION-A7 for E8 only
